name: 08332 · Millville, NJ
findings: ZIP 08332 (Millville) has 116 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08332 (Millville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
